The gap the previous note named is still open and is restated rather than quietly closed: tdd/e2e/test_harness_card_loop.py (US-2 shaped: card -> harness agent -> branch pushed -> in_review) does not exist. Its first blocker is now GONE - the openai-harness dispatch vocabulary landed and the verifier drove the whole loop by hand through a pipeline step and through the Playground. Its SECOND blocker stands: T3's backend is a HOST uvicorn subprocess while step containers are Docker siblings, and on this host no single base_url reaches both positions (host.docker.internal resolves to 192.168.10.224 from the host and 192.168.65.254 from a container; only the second reaches a published port). A THIRD blocker was found by the verifier and is new: cards cannot carry runner_type='openai-harness' at all - app.models.card.RunnerType has no such member and POST /api/repos/{id}/cards 422s - so a card-shaped T3 test cannot be written until that enum gains it. PREVIOUS NOTE FOLLOWS. --- MILESTONE 14: NO T3 TESTS ADDED, and that is a stated gap rather than a silent one (R4). The design named tdd/e2e/test_harness_card_loop.py - US-2 shaped, card -> harness agent -> branch pushed -> in_review, against the mock endpoint at zero cost. Two things blocked it. (1) The `openai-harness` dispatch vocabulary had not landed, so the card cannot start. (2) The T3 backend runs as a HOST uvicorn subprocess while step containers are Docker siblings, so the endpoint's base_url would have to be reachable from both positions at once - and on this host it is not: `host.docker.internal` resolves to the LAN address from the host (192.168.10.224) and to the gateway from a container (192.168.65.254), and only the second reaches a published port. The T2 lane does not have that problem (both ends are containers on lazyaf-network) and covers the harness for real; the dogfood pipeline covers the card path on every push. Whoever adds the T3 test must either move its backend onto the compose network or give the endpoint an address both positions share. PREVIOUS NOTE FOLLOWS. --- e2e quick tier (tdd/e2e -m 'not slow'). RAISED 18 -> 21 for the other half of 12.7's R7 gap: its design named tdd/e2e/test_debug_rerun.py for this tier and did not deliver it, so the debug re-run loop was covered only by frontend/e2e/debug.spec.ts - the R8 surface, which no tier runs. Re-measured 19 -> 22 (+3), not guessed. The new file is the exit gate as a test: a run FAILS on a missing file, a debug re-run pauses before the failing step, the SHIPPED CLI terminal client (lazyaf.debug_cmd.run_terminal) attaches over a REAL WebSocket to a REAL uvicorn serving the real app, the developer creates the missing file from the sidecar shell, Ctrl-] r sends a @resume command frame, and the pipeline COMPLETES. It is the only place the CLI's codec and the server's codec meet over a socket rather than in a contract test. It also pins C14 (GET /api/debug/{id} carries no token) and C10 (a debug re-run's trigger_context carries branch and commit_sha and nothing else). Marked local_exec so it opts out of the root conftest's Docker-free stubs: the local execution path here is the production one. T3 keeps the same `build_images.py --check` preflight T2 has, which now covers the sidecar image too. T3 also still carries the 12.5 US-2 card loop (tdd/e2e/test_us2_card_loop.py), deliberately NOT slow so US-2 is covered on every push.
